hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232462 (notice 'No Hookups. There are no hookups available'; description 'RV sites without hookups') + NPS campground record (electricalHookups 0), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 150 campsites: 13 group sites (no RVs or trailers in the group loop) and 73 tent-only, leaving about 65 standard sites that take RVs. Catalog lengths on those run 15-35 ft; about 48 take 25 ft or more. Parallel, back-in and pull-through spurs.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('Glacier Basin Campground: 35 feet') + NPS campground record (totalSites 150, group 13, tentOnly 73, rvMaxLength 35, 'RVs and trailers are not allowed in the group loop') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232462 ('There are 150 campsites'; notice 'maximum vehicle length of 35 feet (Trailer Length = Trailer + Hitch + Vehicle)') + rec.gov campsite catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-27

values.note: One solar shower stall; bring your own solar shower bag. Food storage lockers; firewood sold in the campground 5-8 p.m. (one rec.gov notice says it is not sold - the two notices conflict).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232462 ('Flush toilets and drinking water are provided'; 'Dump Station'; 'No Shower or Laundry facilities in the campground') + NPS campground record (showers None, laundry No, campStore No, internetConnectivity No, dumpStation Yes - seasonal; 'One solar shower stall are available; visitors must provide their own solar heated shower bag'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 2026 season: May 21 through the night of September 7 (closes at noon September 8). NPS lists the summer 2027 dates as TBD (check back mid-November).

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232462 (fee description: 'a seasonal campground open from May 21 through the night of September 7, 2026. The campground will close at noon on September 8') + https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/camping.htm (Campground Dates for Summer 2027: 'TBD'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reservation only (recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777); no same-day sales and no booking in person at the park. Some sites open 6 months ahead on a rolling window, some only 2 weeks or 1 week ahead; group sites 1 year ahead. From May 1 to October 15 the 7-night limit is 7 nights in total across all RMNP campgrounds.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232462 (Overview: 'All campsites ... are available by reservation only'; 6-month / 2-week / 1-week releases; 7-night limit; rule maxConsecutiveStay 7) + https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/camping.htm ('There are no same day sales available at RMNP's campgrounds'; 'From May 1 through October 15, you can camp in the park 7 nights total parkwide'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: $35 a night for standard non-electric sites (group sites $50-70). Park entrance fee extra: $30 per vehicle for 1 day or $35 for 7 days (annual and lifetime passes accepted); non-US residents 16 and over pay an extra $100 each unless admitted with an annual or America the Beautiful pass. The camping reservation includes the Timed Entry + Bear Lake Road permit: campers may enter from 1 p.m. on their first day; to enter earlier they need their own timed entry reservation or must arrive outside the timed-entry hours (2026: 9 a.m.-2 p.m. park-wide from May 22 to October 12; Bear Lake Road 5 a.m.-6 p.m. to October 18).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232462 (fee description '$35.00 for standard nonelectric sites'; timed entry notice) + /rates (2026 Peak: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 35) + https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/fees.htm (1-Day Vehicle $30.00, 7-Day Vehicle $35.00, non-US residents $100) + https://www.nps.gov/romo/planyourvisit/timed-entry-permit-system.htm, read 2026-10-27

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232462 (notice 'If you use a Senior or Access Pass for a camping fee discount while booking a reservation, you must present the pass and photo ID upon check-in'), read 2026-10-27

note: Rocky Mountain NP campground on Bear Lake Road, ~8,500 ft, with peak views; fir and pine with open meadows. A free park shuttle stop in the campground serves the Bear Lake Road trailheads. Generators allowed 7:30-10 a.m. and 4-8:30 p.m. in Loops A, B, D and part of C (not Loop C sites 76-104 or the group sites). --Claude
